criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Set Alarm
categories.definition: Requests to set an alarm for a specific time or date.

categories.name: Set Reminder
categories.definition: Requests to set a reminder for a specific task or event.

categories.name: Delete Reminder
categories.definition: Requests to delete an existing reminder.

categories.name: Modify Reminder
categories.definition: Requests to change details of an existing reminder.

categories.name: Set Timer
categories.definition: Requests to set a timer for a specific duration.

categories.name: Modify Timer
categories.definition: Requests to modify an existing timer, such as pausing or restarting.

categories.name: Weather Inquiry
categories.definition: Requests for weather information or forecasts.

categories.name: News Inquiry
categories.definition: Requests for news updates or specific news stories.

categories.name: Play Music
categories.definition: Requests to play music or specific songs.

categories.name: Modify Music Playback
categories.definition: Requests to change music playback, such as skipping or repeating a song.

categories.name: Call Contact
categories.definition: Requests to initiate a phone call with a specific contact.

categories.name: Send Message
categories.definition: Requests to send a text or video message to a contact.

categories.name: Modify Call
categories.definition: Requests to modify an ongoing call, such as adding participants or ending the call.

categories.name: Recipe Inquiry
categories.definition: Requests for cooking recipes or cooking instructions.

categories.name: Calorie Inquiry
categories.definition: Requests for calorie information of specific foods.

categories.name: Location Inquiry
categories.definition: Requests for information about a person's location or residence.

categories.name: Event Inquiry
categories.definition: Requests for information about events happening at a specific time or location.

categories.name: Contact Information Inquiry
categories.definition: Requests for information about a contact's details or relationships.

categories.name: Modify Alarm
categories.definition: Requests to change details of an existing alarm.

categories.name: Delete Alarm
categories.definition: Requests to delete an existing alarm.

categories.name: General Inquiry
categories.definition: Requests for general information not covered by other categories.

categories.name: Mark Availability
categories.definition: Requests to mark the user's availability status.
